insights:
DeepSeek raised prices sharply across its mid-tier line. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash moved from $0.158 to $0.600 per million tokens, a 280% increase, and the dated DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-20260910 (Max) moved identically. DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 doubled from $1.10 to $2.20, up 100%, in both the reasoning and non-reasoning variants.

The same vendor cut elsewhere. DeepSeek V4 Flash Latest fell 56%, from $0.190 to $0.084, while DeepSeek Flash Latest dropped 37% to $0.100. MoonshotAI's Kimi Latest fell 33%, from $8.16 to $5.49. Qwen3.5 397B A17B went the other way, up 47% from $1.04 to $1.53 in both variants.

On the frontier, Muse Spark 1.3 dropped from #6 to out of the top 10 and left the intelligence frontier. A new Muse Spark 1.3 (Max) was listed at $2.25 with no intelligence score yet. Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite (batch) was removed. In secondary speed data, Granite 4.2 30B gained 49% throughput, from 41 to 61 tokens per second.
